sentences.text: 2. The petitioners apprehends their arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under Sections 498A and other allied Sections of the Indian Penal Code.
3. Allegedly, the petitioners, who are the in-laws of the informant are said to have assaulted her and ousted her from her matrimonial house.
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioners that petitioners are quite innocent and have committed no offence.
They have been falsely implicated in this case.
No such occurrence, in the manner as alleged, has ever taken place.

The Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.63039 of 2023(2)
dt.19-10-2023 allegation levelled against the petitioners is not specific rather general and omnibus in nature.
Petitioners are the in-laws of the informant and there is no specific overt act against them.
